messages.subject: Global Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Shaw Energy Team,

Your senior recruiting work across upstream, midstream, downstream and energy technology aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy growth depends on regulatory coordination, institutional trust and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile and open to senior cross-border appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
